name: file-viewer
title: File Viewer
description: A full-screen dark overlay for stored files — images with a blur-up, zoom and pan; PDFs rendered page by page with a lazily loaded pdf.js over range requests; video and audio in the system players; the first megabyte of text, CSV (a table) and Markdown; Excel workbooks (sheet tabs, the first 500 rows) and Word documents, read by lazily loaded SheetJS and mammoth; app-parsed previews through loadPreview; a file card with a thumbnail and Download for everything else — paged with arrows, side buttons or a swipe.

meta.whenToUse: Opening stored files full screen from attachment tiles, a product's files or a gallery — images to zoom, PDFs to read, video and audio to play, text, CSV, Markdown, Excel and Word files to read, other Office files as a card (or the app's own parsed preview through loadPreview).
meta.whenNotToUse: An inline player on a page (VideoPlayer, AudioPlayer), or a general-purpose modal (Dialog).
